messages:
maya: FYI — we're seeing a spike in leads unassigned >60s this morning. HubSpot assignment lag when enrichment webhook stalls.

omar: ack. timeline? logs?

maya: started ~09:12am PT, ~450 leads over 20m window, 12% missed SLA. Hubspot webhook retries show 3s->30s backoff when enrich service slow.

elaine: is this the enrichment call blocking assignment? We do enrich before claim in workflow.

maya: yes. current HS workflow: assign -> call enrichment -> confirm owner. If enrich slow, assign waits. snippet:
```
workflow: assign_owner()
  -> call enrichment(api)
  -> if enrichment.ok assign.confirm
```

sam_gtm: we built the workflow to avoid empty owners — but UX cost is high. Suggest switching to optimistic assign + async enrich.

omar: agree. quick fix: 1) change HS workflow to assign immediately (owner placeholder) 2) enqueue enrichment async 3) heartbeat to patch owner when enrich completes. Also add fallback pool after 30s.

maya: proposed rollout:
- 10am PT toggle optimistic-assign flag
- add fallback owner pool (qa-inbound) at 30s
- reduce webhook retries to fail faster (max 10s)
- add Prometheus metric inbound.assign.latency tag 'enrichment_block'

elaine: can we do a canary for 5% first?

sam_gtm: yes. 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 15m intervals. I'll own the runbook.

ops-bot: deploy starting: hubspot/workflows/optimistic-assign toggle -> canary=5%

deploy-bot: hubspot webhook config updated, retries set to [1,3,6]s for canary.

omar: also add round-robin fix: ensure claim counter increments on first assign attempt, not on successful enrichment. prevents jitter when retries race.

maya: thanks. Sam, can you update the inbound playbook link and SLA note? https://redwood.company/playbook/inbound

sam_gtm: will do. I'll post postmortem if we still see >5% misses after full rollout.

maya: :thumbsup: tagging @sales for visibility.

sales: noted — we'll surface to reps.
